test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two ropes, one 8 m long and the other 14 m long are to be cut into pieces of the same length. What will the maximum possible length of each piece be?
solution:
**Given:**

Two rope length = 8 m and 14 m

**Calculation:**

⇒ 8 = 2 x 2 x 2

⇒ 14 = 2 x 7

⇒ HCF (Highest Common Factor) of 8 and 14 = 2

**∴ Maximum possible length of each piece is 2 m.**
